### PG&E Corporation Schedules Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call


September 24, 2026


OAKLAND, Calif.


, Sept. 24, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- PG&E Corporation (NYSE: PCG) will hold a conference call on Thursday, October 22, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. Eastern Time (8:00 a.m. Pacific Time) to discuss its third quarter 2026 results. The public can access the conference call through a simultaneous webcast. The link is provided below and will also be available from the PG&E Corporation website.


What:


Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Call


When:


Thursday, October 22, 2026 at 11:00 a.m. Eastern Time


Where:


[http://investor.pgecorp.com/news-events/events-and-presentations/default.aspx](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4782839-1&h=2409402233&u=http%3A%2F%2Finvestor.pgecorp.com%2Fnews-events%2Fevents-and-presentations%2Fdefault.aspx&a=http%3A%2F%2Finvestor.pgecorp.com%2Fnews-events%2Fevents-and-presentations%2Fdefault.aspx)


A replay of the live conference call and webcast will be available at[http://investor.pgecorp.com/news-events/events-and-presentations/default.aspx](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4782839-1&h=2409402233&u=http%3A%2F%2Finvestor.pgecorp.com%2Fnews-events%2Fevents-and-presentations%2Fdefault.aspx&a=http%3A%2F%2Finvestor.pgecorp.com%2Fnews-events%2Fevents-and-presentations%2Fdefault.aspx) .


Alternatively, a toll-free replay of the conference call may be accessed shortly after the live call through October 29, 2026 by dialing (800) 770-2030. Confirmation code 92587 will be required to access the replay.


Please contact Investor Relations atinvrel@pge-corp.com if you have any questions.


PG&E Corporation (NYSE: PCG) is a holding company headquartered in Oakland. It is the parent company of Pacific Gas and Electric Company, an energy company that serves 16 million Californians across a 70,000-square-mile service area in Northern and Central California. For more information, visit[http://www.pgecorp.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4782839-1&h=2764389584&u=https%3A%2F%2Fcts.businesswire.com%2Fct%2FCT%3Fid%3Dsmartlink%26url%3Dhttp%253A%252F%252Fwww.pgecorp.com%252F%26esheet%3D52597653%26newsitemid%3D20220315006062%26lan%3Den-US%26anchor%3Dhttp%253A%252F%252Fwww.pgecorp.com%26index%3D1%26md5%3Dd8d278ba555b4c75639f91ec98d7f853&a=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.pgecorp.com) .
